raw.rationale: Glucocorticoid receptor agonists are broadly cytostatic/cytotoxic in lymphoid malignancies but this PRISM lineage list lacks lymphoid lines, and at 2.5 µM for 5 days dexamethasone-like compounds show little lineage-selective killing among common solid-tumor lineages. Published PRISM/CTRP data indicate low selective-kill rates for NR3C1 agonists outside blood cancers, so probabilities are near the low base rate with modest elevation in skin and breast due to GR expression and context-dependent antiproliferative effects.
